key_difference: (D) duplicates an uncapped drain loop in both cleanupThreadData() and clearEvents() instead of routing cleanupThreadData() through a single clearEvents() that swaps the list out under the mutex, resets startOffset/insertionOffset, and caps the passes at MaxPasses. As a result, (D) can loop forever if an event destructor always re-posts, and its clearEvents() still touches postEventList without holding the mutex.
